Name: Woolly Goat
Author: ArrynHellfire
Description:
The Woolly Goat can be purchased from Marnie after building a Deluxe Barn. Produces Goat Milk every 2 days, just like the regular goat. It will also shed wool once a week when the friendship is high enough (at the same time as when it will start producing Large Goat Milk). Note; it needs the milk pail to get the wool as if you were milking it, I could probably fix that but it's a complete hassle and this is my first mod ever. You won't notice the quirk once you put an autograbber down anyway. 

Sprites made by me, mostly a recolour of the original goat, but please don't copy them : )


Patchnotes:
1.2: Reduced the shop price of the Woolly Goat.
